images.madyan_market: An ancient desert trading town market at golden hour with empty wooden stalls full of grain sacks, fruit, spices and brass balance scales with weights, low flat-roofed mud-brick houses, palm trees, the market is empty.
images.scale_tilted: Close-up of an old brass balance scale that is secretly tilted, a tiny hidden pebble stuck under one pan, dramatic side light, suspicious mood.
images.scale_balanced: Close-up of an old brass balance scale perfectly level with honest weights and a heap of grain, warm golden light, calm and fair.
images.blocked_road: A desert road at dusk partly blocked by rocks, a small abandoned campfire beside it, long shadows, uneasy but not scary.
images.madyan_town_evening: A desert town of low flat-roofed mud-brick houses seen from a nearby hill at dusk, warm lights in the windows, palm groves around, ordinary and calm.
images.storm_far: Seen from a far-away safe green hill at dawn, a tiny distant town of low flat-roofed houses under dark clouds with faint lightning on the horizon, the foreground peaceful and calm.
images.empty_town_morning: A desert town of low flat-roofed mud-brick houses in quiet morning light, empty streets, sand drifting gently, silent and still, not scary.
images.grain_pile_market: A pile of golden grain on a cloth at a market stall in daylight, a wooden scoop has dug into it and a darker damp layer of grain is visible beneath the dry golden top.
